cards.title: Family sexual abuse: How to protect and support
cards.body: When a family member discloses childhood sexual abuse, prioritize making them feel safe to share at their own pace. Consider what danger the perpetrator may pose to other family members, especially younger relatives.

cards.title: Empty nest: Navigating the pain of children leaving
cards.body: Parents experience genuine grief when their children leave for university, despite it being a natural life stage. Acknowledging this emotional upheaval—rather than dismissing it—helps normalize this difficult transition.

cards.title: Taking toddlers to music festivals: A parent's perspective
cards.body: Bringing young children to festivals isn't about partying—it's about shared family experiences and creating memories together. Families can add joy and magic to events that adults might otherwise dominate.

cards.title: When child behavior changes: Consider immune system factors
cards.body: When a child's behavior shifts dramatically, parents and therapists often focus on psychological causes first. Recent research suggests the immune system may play a significant role in sudden behavioral changes worth investigating.
